inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-30T06:30:00Z (TSE regular close, 15:30 JST; not an after-hours print)
inputs.share_count_basis: 449,204,554 shares issued less 611,469 treasury shares at 30 Sep 2026 (H1 FY2026 tanshin, post the April 2026 global offering of 51.3m shares). No dilutive securities are disclosed (no option or convertible programme), so basic = fully diluted. Held FLAT: no SBC to charge and no further issuance announced; the planned SMBC Nikko third-party allotment (7.7m shares) was cancelled.
inputs.fiscal_label_note: Repo labels follow the END year: repo FY2026 = company 'FY2025' (year ended 31 Mar 2026, revenue JPY 453.3bn); repo FY2027 = company 'FY2026' (year ending 31 Mar 2027), which is the guidance year. fy0 = repo FY2026.
inputs.net_debt_note: Bonds and borrowings non-current 119,692 + current borrowings 20,000 = 139,692 less cash 77,759 at 30 Sep 2026 (H1 tanshin balance sheet). Lease liabilities (c. JPY 7.0bn at 31 Mar 2026) are EXCLUDED from net debt under lease treatment (B). The JPY 96.9bn offering proceeds and JPY 78.1bn of debt repayment in H1 are already in these balances. The JPY 15/share year-end dividend (c. JPY 6.7bn) is not yet deducted.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in JPY, the currency of the flows and the quote. 10y JGB c. 1.6% (Oct 2026, approximate), JPY equity risk premium 6.0%, beta 1.1 for a volatile two-product specialty pharma -> cost of equity c. 8.2%; after-tax cost of debt c. 1.3% at a 15% debt weight (JPY 140bn debt vs c. JPY 845bn market cap) -> WACC c. 7.2%, rounded UP to 8.0% to reflect thin liquidity in the post-offering float and the house JPY reference band (7-9%). Risk is charged ONCE: the same 8.0% is used in all three scenarios; patent-cliff, concentration and pipeline risk live in the scenario flows and weights, not in a WACC premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost. The full lease cash payment (principal JPY 2,540m + interest JPY 182m = JPY 2,722m in repo FY2026, 0.6% of revenue) is charged inside EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path (0.5% forward); lease liabilities are excluded from net debt; da_pct_path is D&A EX right-of-use depreciation (c. JPY 18bn of the JPY 20.8bn FY2026 total) so the lease is not charged twice in cash-tax EBIT.
inputs.nci_treatment: None required. Non-controlling interests were material FY2020-FY2023 (Sumitovant) but are nil since the Myovant/Urovant squeeze-outs and the Asia divestiture: total equity = equity attributable to owners (JPY 431,105m) at 30 Sep 2026, and net profit = attributable profit. FY0 flows are attributable-only with no bridge deduction.
inputs.sbc_note: WARNING: stock-based compensation is not disclosed in the FY2026 annual report or notes (no share-based payment note; the parser left the column blank, not zero). Treated as an SBC-zero market: sbc_pct_path is held explicitly at 0, house and street bases coincide, band_position is null. Any undisclosed director restricted-stock plan would be immaterial (<0.1% of revenue) for a JPY 450bn-revenue Japanese filer, so the overstatement from omitting it is small, but it is unquantified. SBC-adjusted sanity-check multiples may read null for this reason.
inputs.fcf_base_note: last_fcf = reported FCF = OCF 71,715 - PP&E capex 4,609 - intangibles capex 2,703 = 64,403 (repo FY2026 tanshin cash-flow statement). The JPY 49.0bn Asia divestiture gain is non-cash and is already reversed out of OCF; the proceeds (JPY 30.5bn) sit in investing and are not in FCF. The year did however carry a c. USD 100m (c. JPY 15bn) ORGOVYX sales milestone and a JPY 50.8bn receivables build, so FY2026 FCF is NOT used as the base of the projection; the forward FCF is built from a normalised, ex-milestone revenue and EBITDA margin path (see assumptions). After the FY2026 lease cash of JPY 2,722m, FY0 owner FCF under treatment (B) was JPY 61.7bn.
inputs.normalisation_note: Peak-earnings guard. Repo FY2026 core operating profit of JPY 105.9bn includes JPY 52.3bn of 'Others (core basis)', essentially the JPY 49.0bn Asia divestiture gain; ex that, core OP was c. JPY 55bn (12% of revenue) and ex the USD 100m milestone c. JPY 40bn. Company-FY2026 guidance (repo FY2027, year ending Mar-2027) of revenue JPY 565bn / core OP JPY 105bn includes a USD 325m (c. JPY 51bn at USD/JPY 157) ORGOVYX sales milestone from Pfizer expected in H2 at ~100% margin; ex-milestone the guidance is revenue c. JPY 514bn and core OP c. JPY 54bn. H1 actual core OP of JPY 42.1bn (15.8% margin, no milestone) implies management's H2 is very conservative, so the base takes ex-milestone core OP of c. JPY 60bn (EBITDA c. 15.5%) for year 1. The milestone itself is carried in equity_bridge, after tax, not in the flows.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical') with the adaptations file applied: JPY-built WACC, lease treatment (B), NCI nil, matching-asset rule (FVOCI equity instruments and equity-method investments added to the bridge because their dividend/profit share is excluded from the EBITDA flows), SBC-zero market. Not routed to a crisis/asset waterfall: the company is solvent, profitable and has just raised equity; the FY2023-24 crisis is history, not the forward state. 10-year horizon because the patent cliffs on ORGOVYX (relugolix) and GEMTESA (vibegron) fall inside years 6-9, and a 5-year build would capitalise peak-product margins in perpetuity. Terminal cap multiple 12x (base) because this is a patent-cliff business, per the method's 12-15x guidance for structurally slower names. First valuation of this ticker: no prior DCF, no reconciliation block.

equity_bridge.item: ORGOVYX USD 325m Pfizer sales milestone (company-FY2026 H2, i.e. within 12 months), after c. 5% cash tax: 325 x 157 x 0.95
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 presentation p.9: 'Sales milestone revenue related to ORGOVYX USD 325m (sales exceeding USD 1.0B)' is inside the JPY 565bn revenue guidance and the JPY 105bn core OP guidance; excluded from the projected revenue path (which is ex-milestone) and carried here as a one-off cash receipt. Taxed at the near-term cash rate, not statutory, because of JPY 255.8bn of unrecognised tax-loss carryforwards.

equity_bridge.item: FVOCI equity instruments at fair value (JPY 31,143m at 31 Mar 2026 + JPY 15,184m of equity instruments returned from the retirement benefit trust in H1 FY2026)
equity_bridge.note: FY2026 notes, financial assets at FVOCI table; H1 FY2026 cash-flow statement line 'Increase in equity instruments resulting from the return of retirement benefit trust assets'. Dividend income on these (JPY 599m FY2026) is excluded from the EBITDA-based flows, so the asset goes in the bridge (matching-asset rule).

equity_bridge.item: Investments accounted for using the equity method, at book (Marubeni Asia JV, RACTHERA/S-RACMO etc.)
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 balance sheet at 30 Sep 2026. Share of profit of equity-method investees sits below operating profit and is excluded from the flows; the JV was formed in 2025 at fair value so book is a fair proxy.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: guidance-anchored base path (ex-milestone FY2027 +13.4%, then 6/6/5/3% to FY2031), not a historical CAGR
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Historical CAGRs are crisis-distorted and unusable as a forward anchor: revenue -6.6%/-2.6%, equity -10.4%/-12.8% (3y/5y) reflect the Feb-2023 Latuda loss of exclusivity, the Sumitovant impairments and the Asia divestiture; the 3-year EPS and FCF CAGRs are undefined because FY2023 was a loss year; the +13.7% 5-year EPS CAGR is flattered by the JPY 49bn one-off gain in FY2026. Equity CAGR diverges from EPS CAGR by far more than 30%. The base path is anchored to management guidance and the Boost 2028 KPI (ORGOVYX + GEMTESA > JPY 350bn in company-FY2028, c. 7% p.a. in USD) instead.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF throughout (SBC undisclosed/immaterial; interest income not stripped because the company is net-debt, not net-cash). FY2023 and FY2024 FCF of -0.8bn and -257.6bn are crisis years and FY2026's 64.4bn carries a c. JPY 15bn milestone; none of the series is a steady state.

base.growth_rationale: Y1 = company-FY2026 revenue guidance JPY 565bn less the USD 325m milestone = c. JPY 514bn (+13.4% on 453.3bn; underlying growth is higher because FY2026 also carried a USD 100m milestone and four months of the divested Asia subsidiaries). Y2-Y5 taper 6/6/5/3%: ORGOVYX and GEMTESA grow c. 7% p.a. in USD toward the JPY 250bn/150bn peak targets (Boost 2028 KPI > JPY 350bn combined in company-FY2028), XEPLION adds in Japan, enzomenib launches in company-FY2027 and partially replaces the APTIOM/Latuda run-off; USD/JPY held at the guidance rate of 157. Y6-Y10 -2/-6/-6/-4/-2%: GEMTESA (vibegron) and then ORGOVYX (relugolix) lose US exclusivity in the early-to-mid 2030s and erode at a pharma-typical pace, with enzomenib, nuvisertib and AMCHEPRY replacing only part of the lost revenue. Year-10 revenue c. JPY 510bn, roughly back to year 1.
base.margin_rationale: IFRS EBITDA (operating profit + D&A, before the separate 0.5% lease charge). Y1 15.5%: ex-milestone core OP c. JPY 60bn (above the implied-guidance 54bn because H1 ran at 15.8% core OP margin with no milestone) plus c. JPY 19.5bn D&A. Ramp to 19% by Y5 on operating leverage (SG&A guided flat-to-down post restructuring, R&D c. 10% of revenue) -- still below the 20.8-21.6% EBITDA margins of FY2018/FY2020 when Latuda was on patent. Compress to 14% by Y10 as the high-margin exclusivity products go generic.
base.tax_rationale: Cash tax rate ramps from 6% to 27%. JPY 255.8bn of tax-loss carryforwards, JPY 35.5bn of tax credits and JPY 98.2bn of deductible temporary differences carry NO deferred tax asset (FY2026 notes), FY2026 cash tax paid was JPY 4.6bn and company guides JPY 5bn of tax expense on JPY 99bn of pre-tax profit for FY2027. At c. JPY 60-90bn of taxable profit a year, and with the US 80%-of-income NOL limitation, the shelter is exhausted in roughly four years; the rate then settles at 27%, a blend of Japan's 30.6% statutory rate and US federal+state c. 25% less R&D credits. The shelter is NOT perpetuated into the terminal value.
base.capex_da_rationale: D&A ex right-of-use c. JPY 18bn (3.4% of Y1 revenue), mostly amortisation of the acquired Sumitovant product rights, declining toward 3.0%. Capex 2.0% rising to 2.5% (FY2026 actual 1.6%, FY2025 3.3%, FY2027 capex-plus-investments guidance JPY 12bn, and the regenerative-medicine manufacturing build-out). D&A above capex in the early years is the run-off of acquired intangibles, which is mirrored by the revenue cliff in years 6-10 rather than assumed to be replaced for free.
base.wc_rationale: Working capital consumes 15% of each year's revenue increase: receivables (152bn) plus inventories (90bn) far exceed payables (62bn) at 30 Sep 2026, US specialty-pharmacy terms are long, and FY2026 showed a JPY 50.8bn receivables build on a JPY 54bn revenue increase (partly milestone and deconsolidation timing). The same capture releases cash as revenue declines in the cliff years.
base.terminal_rationale: g = 1.0% in JPY for a post-cliff specialty pharma; cap 12x year-10 FCF because the terminal year sits after both patent cliffs and the next cycle of replacement is unproven.

bull.narrative: Bull axes: GEMTESA's H1 pricing gain proves durable and the beta-3 class keeps taking share from antimuscarinics despite mirabegron generics; ORGOVYX reaches its JPY 250bn peak early on oral-ADT share gains plus the Medicare out-of-pocket cap; enzomenib (menin inhibitor, Breakthrough Therapy) launches in company-FY2027 and nuvisertib in FY2028 and each tracks toward the > JPY 100bn peak, so the mid-2030s LOE on vibegron and relugolix is largely offset; AMCHEPRY converts its conditional approval into a commercial franchise; SG&A discipline holds and EBITDA margins reach 22%, above the pre-crisis 21%. Revenue still dips modestly in years 7-9 because no pipeline schedule fully replaces two products that are 60% of sales.

bear.narrative: Bear axes: the yen strengthens back toward 140 (every JPY 10 on USD/JPY is c. JPY 27bn of revenue), GEMTESA's 'temporary pricing impacts' reverse and mirabegron generics compress OAB class pricing, ORGOVYX growth stalls short of its peak target, enzomenib slips or fails in the pivotal programme and nuvisertib is not enough on its own, so when vibegron and relugolix lose exclusivity from the early 2030s there is nothing behind them -- a repeat of the Latuda cliff that collapsed equity from JPY 608bn to 156bn. Margins never clear 14% because R&D cannot be cut without abandoning the pipeline, and fall to 9% post-cliff. Revenue roughly halves to c. JPY 320bn by year 10. The terminal value is capped at 10x and sits above the zero floor, so this path is a deep impairment, not insolvency: net debt is only JPY 62bn after the offering.

scenario_narratives.base: Base: management's company-FY2026 guidance holds ex the one-off USD 325m milestone (which is credited separately in the bridge); ORGOVYX and GEMTESA grow c. 7% a year in USD toward their 2030s peak targets at a flat USD/JPY 157; enzomenib launches on schedule and partially replaces the Japan run-off; EBITDA margin expands from 15.5% to 19% by FY2031 on post-restructuring SG&A discipline; cash tax stays near zero for four years while JPY 256bn of unrecognised tax losses are consumed, then normalises to 27%; the vibegron and relugolix US patent cliffs in years 6-9 take revenue back to roughly year-1 levels and margins to 14%, with the pipeline covering only part of the gap. Terminal value capped at 12x year-10 FCF.
scenario_narratives.bull: Bull: both core products reach peak early, enzomenib and nuvisertib each become > JPY 100bn franchises and AMCHEPRY commercialises, so the LOE dip is shallow; margins reach 22%; terminal 14x / 1.5%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Bear: yen strength, GEMTESA pricing reversal and a pipeline miss leave the company facing the vibegron/relugolix cliffs with no replacement -- revenue halves by year 10, margins fall to 9%, terminal 10x / 0.5%. Still above the zero floor.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30% and bull cut from 35% to 20%. Bear up: earnings rest on two US products that both lose exclusivity inside the forecast horizon, the replacement pipeline is pre-commercial (enzomenib FY2027 launch at the earliest, nuvisertib FY2028, AMCHEPRY only conditionally approved), FX is a single large external driver, and the FY2023-24 collapse shows how fast this exact structure can fail. Bull down: it requires several independent things to go right at once -- two pivotal programmes, a cell-therapy commercialisation, durable GEMTESA pricing and a weak yen. Base at 50% because management has beaten its own Reboot 2027 targets a year early and the H1 run-rate already exceeds the ex-milestone full-year guidance.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the ex-one-off cash flows of a two-product US specialty pharma through its coming patent cliffs, not the headline record year. Three one-offs are stripped or isolated: the JPY 49bn Asia divestiture gain (non-cash, already out of FCF), the USD 100m FY2026 and USD 325m FY2027 ORGOVYX milestones (the latter credited once in the bridge), and the near-zero cash tax rate (consumed over four years, never capitalised). The 10-year horizon exists so that the vibegron and relugolix LOEs are inside the explicit period and the terminal value is struck on a post-cliff, partially-replaced revenue base at a 12x cap. The bridge adds the milestone, the FVOCI cross-shareholdings and the equity-method JV because their income is outside the EBITDA flows. Risk is charged once, in the scenario flows and the 30/50/20 weights, not in the discount rate.
key_risks_to_valuation: Patent cliff timing: the base assumes GEMTESA (vibegron) erodes from year 6 and ORGOVYX (relugolix) from year 7-8; a paediatric or patent-term extension that pushes either out two years adds materially to value, an earlier generic entry or a successful Paragraph IV challenge removes it.
Two-product concentration: ORGOVYX and GEMTESA are c. 60% of revenue; a pricing, safety or formulary setback on either flows straight through a 15-19% margin.
Pipeline binary: enzomenib and nuvisertib are modelled as partial replacements in the base; the bull/bear spread is largely their success or failure.
USD/JPY: c. 57% of revenue is USD; the base holds 157. A move to 140 is c. JPY 27bn of revenue and most of it is margin.
Tax-loss consumption: the base exhausts the JPY 256bn shelter in four years; if the US 80% limitation bites harder or the Japanese losses expire unused, cash tax rises sooner.
Working-capital build: FY2026 absorbed JPY 51bn into receivables; a structurally longer US cash cycle than the -15% capture assumes would cut FCF in the growth years.
SBC is undisclosed; treated as zero. Immaterial for a Japanese filer but unquantified.
Equity-method and FVOCI holdings (JPY 85.7bn, c. JPY 191/share) are taken at book/fair value in the bridge; a reader who prefers to exclude them should deduct c. JPY 190 per share.

warnings: sbc_source is 'unavailable': stock-based compensation is not disclosed in the filings. The model proceeds on unadjusted FCF with SBC explicitly at 0%; the valuation overstates intrinsic value by an unquantified but (for a Japanese filer of this size) immaterial amount. Sanity-check SBC-adjusted multiples may read null.

Year-1 revenue (JPY 514bn) is deliberately BELOW the company's JPY 565bn guidance: the USD 325m ORGOVYX milestone is excluded from the flows and credited once, after tax, in equity_bridge. Do not read the gap as a guidance miss.
